who: any janusm-readers member with the 'lie-reg' read set (a border reader is enough; no CMR expertise needed)
blinding: blind to LGE and to every scar output; the scar map is never drawn on these views

shows.chosen_by: code: the short-axis planes at 25 %, 50 % and 75 % of the carried LV long axis (from the geometry module)
shows.layout: per slice: the first-pass CT (left) and the LIE (right), same plane, same zoom; the carried endocardial and epicardial borders drawn on both; a toggle shows the LIE without borders
shows.window: LIE window centred on the LIE blood median, width 3x (blood - remote); first-pass window from the read protocol

patient_result: pass if all three slices pass; else fail

on_fail.step: the reader drags the LIE to a manual initial shift on the mid slice; the chain re-runs once from it (JA29)
on_fail.second_fail: not graded: in the primary analysis every segment of the patient counts as wrong (JA29)

logged_by_code: chain stage that passed (R0 / rigid / affine)
estimated shift (mm) and log-determinant of the transform
